question: In which of the following kingdoms is the eukaryotic cell NOT found?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monera **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eukaryotes are organisms that have membrane-bound cell organelles as well as the membrane-bound nucleus.
 
• Bacteria is not a eukaryotic cell because:
 
 
• Bacteria do not have a nucleus.
 
• It contains a nucleoid region and one of the major aspects of eukaryotes is that they have a nucleus.
 
• Bacteria do not have any organelles apart from ribosomes whereas eukaryotes have membrane-bound or compartmentalized organelles.
 
• Bacteria are simple in structure, whereas eukaryotes are more intricated structure and function wise.
